observations: Front view of a motorcycle with a round headlight, black handlebars, and a white plastic cover over the body.
Side view showing a maroon fuel tank with 'MY100-4' written on it, silver engine casing, black spoked front wheel, and a rear wheel with a silver rim.
Rear three-quarter view showing the same maroon fuel tank with 'MY100-4' visible, a black rear fender, orange rear shock absorbers, and a covered seat.
The motorcycle is parked on a dirt or concrete ground, surrounded by other motorcycles and market items like buckets and bags.
The front fender is chrome, and the front fork is silver. The front wheel has a black rim with a silver outer ring.
The rear wheel has a silver rim and a black tire. The engine is exposed and appears to be a single-cylinder air-cooled unit.
The seat is covered with a transparent plastic sheet, and the body is partially covered with white plastic.
No visible brand name on the fuel tank or engine, but 'MY100-4' is clearly readable on the side of the fuel tank in photo 2.
